title: Celery Highball
ldInstructionsRaw: Celery Syrup: Combine 2 cups of sugar with 1 cup of water in a saucepan of medium heat and stir until the sugar dissolves. Stir in 2 Tbsp. of celery seeds that have been pulverized by a morter & pestle, or spice grinder. Add additional celery seed to taste. Remove from the heat and let cool.
